rationale: The Evaluator feedback recommends reducing the derivative gain kd from 3 to 1.5 to reduce oscillations, lowering the integral gain ki from 0.5 to 0.2 to avoid integral windup, and slightly reducing the base speed from 1.5 to 1.3 to improve stability if stalling occurs. The race data from iteration 0 shows no line loss events and good completion, but the high kd likely causes some oscillation. Therefore, I have adjusted the controller gains accordingly to improve stability and reduce oscillations while maintaining good speed. The geometry remains unchanged as the sensor layout and physical parameters are well balanced and effective. I continue to request a broad set of observations to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss events, steering oscillation, and control effort for further tuning in future iterations.
